list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them (the official exception). Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description. Where the official description does not name a place or a step, the guide says so honestly instead of inventing one.
sources: Exophase — official trophy name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — official trophy name, description and grade
Leonida Case File — our own guide, written from the official description; not yet verified inside the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Treat it as the finish line of the whole case file: work the four roadmap stages in order and this trophy closes the file for you. It cannot be missed — it waits until every other trophy is done.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The platinum pops on its own.

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. This is the first story mission of the game, so it comes naturally as you start playing and cannot be skipped past. Follow the mission prompts until the completion screen appears.
steps: Start the story and play Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

This trophy is missable only in the sense that it belongs to Chapter 1: once the chapter ends you cannot go back and earn it except through a chapter or mission replay if the game offers one. Play the chapter through in order and do not rush past its missions.
steps: Play all Chapter 1 missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion across the whole game to earn this gold trophy. It is the long cleanup trophy: story, side missions, collectibles, activities and challenges all count toward the total, so it comes last, after everything else is nearly done. Use the in-game completion checklist to find what is still missing, and work through it stage by stage. It cannot be missed — it waits until the total hits 100%.
steps: Finish the story and side content.
Clear collectibles, activities and challenges until completion reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. A stunt is any showy driving or riding feat the game counts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like — so they build up naturally while you drive hard, and faster if you deliberately chase jumps and ramps. The official description names no specific stunt spots, so use any open road, ramp or jump you find and keep a running count in your head. It cannot be missed; it is pure grind.
steps: Drive fast and chase jumps, ramps and airtime.
Keep going until the count reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once. The official list counts 9 activity types, so the trick is breadth, not mastery: sample each one — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest — and the trophy pops once the last type is tried. If one type has not registered, check which activities the game lists and try the one you have not touched yet.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 challenges in total, per the official list. This is a skill trophy: each challenge has a gold score threshold, so learn the range's scoring, pick the weapon each challenge favours, and repeat a challenge until the gold medal lands. Work through them one at a time rather than jumping around, and save the hardest for when your aim is warm. It cannot be missed; the range stays open.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range.
Gold-medal all 42 challenges, one at a time.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total, per the official list. Each location has its own race, so the job is to visit all of them and win each one at least once. Learn each course's corners before pushing for speed, and retry a location until the win registers. It cannot be missed; drone races stay available.
steps: Find the Top Fun Drone Race at a location.
Win it, then move to the next location until all 14 are won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: winning the same race twenty times does not count — you need twenty distinct races won. Spread your wins across race types and locations, and keep count of which ones you have already won so you do not repeat them. It cannot be missed; races stay open after the story.
steps: Enter races across different types and locations.
Win 20 distinct races.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level up to four stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — speed and cover matter more than fighting back. The official description names no specific escape spot, so use any route that gets you out of sight. It cannot be missed; it can be tried again any time.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the chain: rob one shop, move straight to the next, then the next, keeping the same wanted level alive the whole time — do not escape the heat in between, and do not let it drop. Plan a route with three shops close together and keep your partner with you. It cannot be missed; retry it any time.

Rob all 3 in a row without losing your Wanted Level.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a crowd rather than a lone enemy, and make every shot count. It cannot be missed; retry it in any fight.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and take all 5 down in one use.
